The General Manager

Karachi. 
RE: DISCLOSURE OF MATERIAL INFORMATION 
Dear Sir, 
Pursuant to Clause 5.6 of the Rule Book of the Pakistan Stock Exchange (PSX) and Sections 
96 & 131 of the Securities Act, 2015, we hereby convey the following: 
The Board of Directors of International Steels Limited in its emergent Board meeting on April 
16, 2024, has approved a Memorandum of Understanding (MOU) to form an entity to explore 
opportunities in collaboration with associated companies. 
We are transmitting this information through PUCARS for your information and record. You 
may please inform the TRE Certificate Holders of the Exchange accordingly. 
Thanking you, 
Yours faithfully, 
For INTERNATIONAL STEELS LTD., 
) YOUSUF H. MIRZA 
Chief Executive Officer
